description: The minimum-energy conical intersections of ethylene's SC- and PC-QD-NEVPT2 states 0 and 1 over its DF-SA3-CASSCF(2,2) (equal weights), cc-pVDZ / cc-pVDZ-JKFIT, each converged by the tree's [optimize] MECI mode from examples/ethylene.xyz. Hartree, bohr. tools/nevpt2_hessian/qd_meci.py over free-breakfast

meci.config:
[molecule]
xyz = "ethylene.xyz"
[basis_set]
basis = "cc-pvdz"
[eri]
mode = "density_fitting"
aux_basis = "cc-pvdz-jkfit"
[scf]
max_iterations = 400
[casscf]
ncas = 2
nelecas = 2
nroots = 3
conv_tol_grad = 1e-10
[nevpt2_gradient]
quasi_degenerate = true
variant = "sc"
[optimize]
meci = [0, 1]
max_gap = 1e-07
max_force = 1.5e-05
rms_force = 1e-05
max_displacement = 6e-05
rms_displacement = 4e-05
max_steps = 200
